question: Who won the Hungarian Grand Prix 2025?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Lando Norris**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Lando Norris Wins Hungarian GP 2025, Cuts Piastri’s Lead.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Lando Norris** won the **Hungarian Grand Prix 2025** at the **Hungaroring** in **Budapest**.

 
 
• 
 
He held off a **late challenge** from **McLaren teammate Oscar Piastri**.

 
 
• 
 
This was **Norris’s 5th win of the season**.

 
 
• 
 
The win **reduced Piastri’s lead** in the **Drivers’ Championship** to just **9 points**.

 
 
• 
 
**George Russell** finished **third** for **Mercedes**.

 
 
• 
 
The result sets up an exciting battle for the title after the **summer break**.
